subject: Pipeline hygiene: BrightLeaf upsell — stage updates & forecast reconciliation
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pipeline hygiene: BrightLeaf upsell — stage updates & forecast reconciliation

Team —

Quick ask as we lock Q4 numbers: BrightLeaf (DEAL-8421) shows as "Negotiation" in HubSpot but the CS playbook indicates a pending deployment milestone that needs to complete before commit. Finance needs a clean entry for our expansion forecast. Please do the following by end of week: 

- Marissa: confirm the deployment milestone status and update the close date if it slips beyond 12/15.
- Rishi: verify that the opportunity owner and renewal baseline are correct in HS (I saw two contact duplicates).
- Vivek: if this is not a true commit-by date, flag it as at-risk for our reforecast.

I attached a hygiene sheet with the fields we use for forecasting. If we can lock the stage and ACV this week I can include it in the Friday commit review. If not, we should move it to the "Upsell: at-risk" bucket and assign a probability adjustment.

Thanks — please reply with short updates so I can consolidate.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: BrightLeaf_pipeline_hygiene_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: BrightLeaf upsell — stage updates & forecast reconciliation

Thanks Sean — quick update from CS side: 

- Deployment: on track for the lab environment (STG) but production deploy is dependent on a legal-approved SSO certificate. Legal flagged the cert request yesterday; engineering estimates 7–10 business days once approved. That pushes probable prod-ready to ~12/22.
- Customer sentiment: high — they validated the ROI numbers in last week's QBR, and Alyssa reiterated willingness to expand once SSO is live.
- Contacts: Dan Cho is the primary technical sponsor; Alyssa Moore is the economic buyer. I flagged the duplicate contact (Dan C. vs Dan Cho) and merged them in HubSpot — Rishi, please confirm the merge looks good on ops side.

I updated the hygiene sheet (attached) with the deployment note and suggested adjusting probability to 40% vs our previous 70% until prod deploy is confirmed. I also added a suggested close date of 2026-12-22.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if we want to decide live.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: BrightLeaf_pipeline_hygiene_sheet.xlsx (updated), BrightLeaf_upsell_proposal_v2.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: BrightLeaf upsell — stage updates & forecast reconciliation

Appreciate the notes. A few finance points: 

- If prod deploy is 12/22 our quarter cut-off for recognized ARR will likely fall into next quarter; for commit reporting we need a clear sign-off (PO or signed amendment) by 12/15 to keep it in Q4 numbers.
- Please confirm the ACV delta you're forecasting for the expansion. The deal in HS lists a $180k expansion ARR; Marissa, is that still accurate given scope changes?
- If the customer can provide a signed amendment no later than 12/15 we can include it in the Friday commit. Otherwise, mark it as a reforecast candidate.

I'll prepare two lines in the commit workbook: one optimistic (if signed by 12/15) and one conservative (move to Jan). FYI I pulled the current HS snapshot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8421 — please make edits there rather than emailing spreadsheets to avoid versioning issues.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Quoted text below from Marissa for visibility:

>
> Thanks Sean — quick update from CS side:
> - Deployment: on track for the lab environment (STG) but production deploy is dependent on a legal-approved SSO certificate...

From: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@brightleafhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: BrightLeaf upsell — stage updates & forecast reconciliation

Hi team,

Thanks for the heads up — quick confirmation from BrightLeaf: we are prioritizing the SSO cert request with Legal and expect an approval window of 5–7 business days. I have asked our IT lead (Dan) to expedite. We can provide a signed amendment for the expansion, but the earliest realistically is the week of 12/20 given our procurement cycles. We don't want to promise a 12/15 sign-off we can't meet.

Proposed path from our side:
- We will move forward with a mutual-action plan: sign amendment week of 12/20, production deploy by 12/22, and go-live validation by 12/29.
- If Redwood needs earlier commitment for reporting, we can lock a partial pre-paid commitment for the first 3 months (50% of ARR) to allow Q4 recognition; I can escalate that internally if required.

Happy to discuss tradeoffs if that helps with your internal reporting.

Best,
Alyssa Moore
Head of Product Ops, BrightLeaf Health
alyssa@brightleafhealth.com

Attachment references: procurement_timeline_v1.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@brightleafhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 16:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: BrightLeaf upsell — stage updates & forecast reconciliation

Alyssa — thanks for the transparency and the partial pre-pay option.

Plan from Redwood: Vivek and I will model two outcomes for Friday commit review (full signed amendment by 12/15 vs partial pre-pay recognized in Q4). Marissa, please mark the HS opportunity as "At-risk — pending procurement" and set probability to 40% for the conservative line. Rishi, please confirm contact merge and that the primary owner is set to me.

Alyssa — if you're open, I'll send a short DocuSign for the partial pre-pay term sheet so procurement has something to review internally (will not obligate the full contract). Let me know and I'll share.

Acknowledged — I'll include both numbers in our Friday commit packet.

—Sean
